correctness.rationale: At characteristic two, the Fermat quintic restricts to a Hermitian form: line isotropy implies L^(4)=L^perp and L^(16)=L; normal bundle O(-3) kills tangent deformations. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all RREF 2-planes over GF(16), justified by this algebraic descent, reproduces 325 lines (75 coordinate-pair and 250 exceptional); Frobenius 3 fixed, one 2-cycle and 80 quartets. Distinct quartets give 48 empty, 14 matching, 12 cycle and 6 clique induced graphs, partitioned by families as claimed. The six rational four-clique centers are consistent with the six F2 points other than [1:1:1:1]. This independently confirms finite-scheme and incidence assertions, not a classification of other twisted forms.
